JAINA_KEYWORD_DEATHRATTLE.title: Deathrattle
JAINA_KEYWORD_CHARGE.title: Charge
JAINA_KEYWORD_CHARGE.description: Can attack immediately after being summoned.
JAINA_KEYWORD_FREEZE.title: Freeze
JAINA_KEYWORD_FREEZE.description: Frozen characters deal 25% less damage with attacks. Stacks up to 4 times. All stacks are removed at end of turn.
JAINA_KEYWORD_TWINSPELL.title: Twinspell
JAINA_KEYWORD_TWINSPELL.description: When you cast a spell with Twinspell, add a copy of that spell to your hand. The copy does not have Twinspell.
JAINA_KEYWORD_EMPOWER.title: Empower
JAINA_KEYWORD_EMPOWER.description: Each stack of Empower increases your Hero Power damage by 1, and summons an extra 1/1 Imp.
JAINA_KEYWORD_FINISHER.title: Finisher
JAINA_KEYWORD_FINISHER.description: When you play a card with Finisher, if you use all your Energy, trigger an additional effect.
JAINA_KEYWORD_SPELL.title: Spell
JAINA_KEYWORD_SPELL.description: Attack and Skill cards are both Spell cards.
JAINA_KEYWORD_BATTLECRY.title: Battlecry
JAINA_KEYWORD_BATTLECRY.description: Battlecry: When this card is played from your hand, its effect triggers immediately.
